channel.title: Synopsys Glossary
channel.description: Definitions of chip design, verification and silicon IP terms

item.title: What are Chiplets? – How Do Chiplets Work?
item.description: Learn how chiplets enable modular semiconductor design, delivering greater flexibility, performance, and efficiency for advanced multi-die design.

item.title: What is ASIL (Automotive Safety Integrity Level)? – Overview
item.description: Explore ASIL levels & how AI-machine learning in vehicles impact safety validation. Discover how Synopsys supports AI-compliant design and verification.

item.title: What is Automotive Hardware Functional Safety?
item.description: Learn about automotive hardware functional safety, its importance in preventing design failures and controlling random faults as defined by ISO 26262 standards.

item.title: What is an Autonomous Car? – How Self-Driving Cars Work
item.description: Discover how autonomous cars sense their environment and operate without human intervention, offering a glimpse into the future of self-driving technology.

item.title: What is Design Planning?
item.description: Design planning is the process by which you manage and minimize engineering tradeoffs related to implementation and design closure.

item.title: What is Integrated Development Environment (IDE)? – How it Works
item.description: An IDE is an Integrated Development Environment that combines tools and features to streamline and improve software development productivity for programmers.

item.title: What is ISO 26262 Functional Safety Standard?
item.description: ISO 26262 ensures automotive safety by mandating a functional development process to minimize risks from E/E system malfunctions in commercial vehicles.

item.title: What is Electronic Design Automation (EDA)? – How it Works
item.description: Electronic Design Automation (EDA) includes software, hardware, and services that support semiconductor design, verification, and manufacturing.

item.title: What is Reinforcement Learning & How Does AI Use It?
item.description: Reinforcement Learning enables systems to learn optimal decisions through interaction, maximizing outcomes with AI-driven exploration and adaptation.

item.title: What is PCI Express (PCIe)? – How it Works?
item.description: Discover PCI Express (PCIe), a standard for connecting peripherals to motherboards, offering high bandwidth and low latency for various applications.
